name: router
description: Routes coding subtasks to the cheapest capable model to save Opus tokens. The main session plans, reviews the whole diff and owns the pass/fail verdict; the router CLI owns the mechanism -- one task at a time on a dedicated branch in your own checkout, under an exclusive lock that rescues your uncommitted work before anything moves, process supervision, the project's own build gate with full-rebuild triggers, and environment-free gates on every diff (scope, secrets, executable bit).
